newsitem.title: USA: US West Coast prods stay steady despite firm NYMEX.
newsitem.headline: US West Coast prods stay steady despite firm NYMEX.

text.p: U.S. West Coast product prices continued flat late Thursday, as refiners were hit hard by expensive crude futures and weak prospects for gasoline.
"The NYMEX is providing crude values that refiners are choking on," one dealer said. But he added NYMEX crude was also proping up wholesale gasoline temporarily.
In distillates, traders had factored in tighter supplies after Arco reported Wednesday that a coker in Los Angeles would stay shut another 10 days following problems last week.
The 42,000 barrel-per-day coker affected crude runs at the refinery, which fell from 260,000 bpd to 190,000 bpd.
